title: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment… before anything was broken.
paragraphs:
When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment… before anything was broken.
The air is calm. The light is gentle. Their eyes hold no fear… their hearts carry no shame.
Everything moves in harmony—creation, humanity, and God in perfect peace.

This is what we were made for.
Unhidden. Unafraid. Fully known… and still fully loved.

And even now, in a world that feels far from Eden, something inside us remembers this design.
A quiet longing… for peace that doesn’t fracture, for love that doesn’t hide.

Maybe that longing is not accidental.
Maybe it’s a reminder… of what God still intends to restore.
I am a witness, not a biblical character—standing in awe of what once was, and what God is bringing back again.
